# Goal of This Repo

**Read this skill first for every task in this repo.**

## About Me

Refer: [about-me skill](../about-me/SKILL.md)

## Goal of Creating This Repository

To create a portfolio level test automation project that I can walk-through and explain in interviews. It will differentiate my resume with a project, rather than just mentioning "Playwright" in the resume. It should demonstrate that I can create and maintain industry level test automation frameworks. It should not be overcomplicated but follows good structure as per POM and industry standards.

I want to create a Playwright automation framework from scratch that:

- Imitates my current organisation repo
- Has E2E UI automation workflows
- Has API hybrid tests to create and delete resources
- Follows industry automation framework standards, as well as Playwright standards
- Has API CRUD tests
- Has Docker and GitHub Actions nightly pipeline schedules within the free tier, with report generation for failures
- Has AI agent integrations
- Has a proper README
